title: ever PALMER|Embroidery Sequin Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
Stun at your next event in this beautifully embroidered gown adorned with shimmering sequins. Designed for elegance and comfort, its intricate embroidery adds a touch of sophistication. Perfect for weddings or upscale parties, it makes you feel confident and radiant, ensuring all eyes are on you as you celebrate in style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Ankle-Length


Sleeve Style: Ruffle Sleeve


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back


Undergarments:Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch
